evals.prompt: Set up an Infisical Secret Rotation for our production PostgreSQL application user, rotating every 30 days. Show me the API request body and tell me exactly what I need to prepare in the database beforehand.

assertions.text: Requires TWO pre-existing database users via username1/username2
States both users must already exist and Infisical does not create them
must_match: already exist|must exist|pre-exist|does not create|Infisical does not

assertions.text: rotationInterval is in days
Maps both username and password via secretsMapping
Warns the application must read the username from Infisical too, since the active user alternates

evals.prompt: Create an Infisical App Connection to AWS using role assumption rather than static keys. Show the exact API request, including the method value and credential field names.

assertions.text: Uses method assume-role
Uses roleArn as the credential field
Posts to the aws connection endpoint
Mentions the External ID requirement in the trust policy

evals.prompt: I want to create an internal Infisical certificate authority using an ECDSA P-256 key. What exact key algorithm value do I pass, and what is the difference between a root and an intermediate CA in Infisical?

assertions.text: Gives the correct ECDSA P-256 wire value EC_prime256v1
Does not offer ECDSA_P256 as the value
Explains root self-signs and intermediate is signed by a parent
Mentions pending-certificate status for an unsigned intermediate

evals.prompt: Using Infisical KMS, I need to sign a large file with an RSA key. Show me how, and explain how to avoid sending the whole file over the network.

assertions.text: Uses the isDigest flag
Explains isDigest true means data is already a hash
must_match: already a hash|already hashed|pre-computed|precomputed|already a digest

assertions.text: Uses a valid RSA signing algorithm value
Notes data is base64-encoded
Uses the sign endpoint

evals.prompt: I want to let Claude Code query our production database through Infisical PAM without giving it a connection string. Show me the command and explain how the credential is kept away from the agent.

assertions.text: Uses infisical pam agentic access
Scopes with the --account flag
Explains the Gateway injects the real credential
Mentions local ports on 127.0.0.1
Mentions the sandbox requirement (macOS or Linux with bubblewrap)

evals.prompt: Using the current Infisical Kubernetes Operator CRDs, sync secrets from Infisical into a Kubernetes Secret and make my Deployment pick up changes automatically. Show the manifests.

assertions.text: Uses the v1beta1 API version
Uses InfisicalStaticSecret rather than the legacy InfisicalSecret
Includes InfisicalConnection and InfisicalAuth resources
Adds the auto-reload annotation for automatic redeployment
Uses sources and targets

evals.prompt: In Infisical, I want developers to be able to see which secrets exist in production and their metadata, but not read any secret values. Which exact permission actions do I grant and which do I withhold?

assertions.text: Grants describeSecret
Withholds readValue
Explains that the legacy read action grants both
Does not tell the user to grant plain read for this

evals.prompt: Set up Infisical Secret Scanning on our GitHub repositories, and also stop developers committing secrets locally in the first place. What App Connection type do I need, and what should I run locally?

assertions.text: Specifies the github-radar App Connection
Warns it is not the same as a plain github connection
Recommends the pre-commit hook install command
Recommends a full scan for existing history

evals.prompt: We want to enforce SAML SSO for our Infisical organization so nobody can log in with a password. What do we need to do first, and what are the risks?

assertions.text: States email domain verification is a prerequisite
Warns password signup is blocked for verified domains
Tells them to set up a break-glass admin with a password beforehand
Gives the /login/admin bypass portal path
Notes Organization Admin is required, not Server Admin

evals.prompt: Our security team needs the exact firewall rules to deploy an Infisical Gateway in our VPC so Infisical can reach a private RDS instance. What ports, in which direction?

assertions.text: States no inbound ports are required on the gateway
Gives outbound TCP 2222 to the relay
Gives outbound TCP 443 to Infisical
Describes the connection as outbound/egress only
Mentions the auto-select relay allowlist caveat or pinning a relay

evals.prompt: I'm writing a script that authenticates to Infisical with a machine identity and needs to list the KMS keys available on our AWS App Connection, so it can fill in a secret sync's config. Show me how.

assertions.text: States the discovery endpoint cannot be called with a machine identity token
Does not present the kms-keys endpoint as a working machine-identity call
Offers a real alternative (query AWS directly, or read the config back from a UI-created sync)

evals.prompt: Create Infisical App Connections for Okta and for Datadog via the API. Give me the exact method value and credentials field names for each.

assertions.text: Okta uses method api-token
Datadog offers token and api-key methods
Posts to the per-connection slug endpoint
Does not invent a generic credentials shape for both

evals.prompt: My automation knows an Infisical App Connection by its name, not its UUID. Can it resolve the connection ID through the API, and does that work with a machine identity token?

assertions.text: Gives the connection-name lookup path
Confirms it accepts a machine identity token
Does not claim you must store the UUID
must_not_match: must store the UUID|no way to look up|only by (its )?UUID
